output.rationale: The requirement specifies a Normal Frequency Withstand of 36 kV, rms. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear suitable for voltage classes up to 38 kV, which meets the withstand voltage requirement. This product is offered as Engineered-to-Order (ETO), ensuring it can be tailored to the specific technical needs of the customer.
